title: Connect to the Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams with your workspace URL (Public Preview)
body: When you sign in to the Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams, you can now enter your workspace URL instead of a server hostname to connect to your Databricks account. See [Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams](/aws/en/integrations/msft-teams).
